meta.name: Vietnamese Calendar Golden Dataset
meta.coreAlgorithm: Hồ Ngọc Đức-style Vietnamese lunisolar conversion; Meeus astronomical basis
importantNotes: This v1 golden file intentionally includes only high-confidence deterministic fields.
Trực, 28 Tú, exact solar-term transition, Hỷ/Tài Thần, cát/hung thần and activity advice are excluded until a canonical convention/source and independently reviewed anchors are locked.
Can Chi month here is explicitly labeled monthCivilLunarConvention; do not use it as a Bát Tự solar-term month.
